workspaceExport.title: Download workspace data
workspaceExport.body: Administrator export of CRM records, contact details, notes, member names/emails, and saved bank details. JSON includes stable IDs and relationships; CSV contains customers only. Credentials and authentication tokens are excluded.
workspaceExport.liveRead: Export reads data in pages while the workspace remains active. Concurrent edits may appear inconsistently; this is not a backup snapshot.
